title: Marketing Manager
description:
Marketing Executive (Temporary Contract)

Location: Chester
Salary: Up to £20.51 per hour
Contract: Temporary, minimum 3-month assignment
Hours: Monday to Friday, 9:00am - 5:30pm
Start Date: ASAP

About the Role

We are seeking an enthusiastic and creative Marketing Executive to join a well-established and highly tenured team on a temporary basis for a minimum of three months. This role has arisen to provide cover for a team member who is currently absent, offering an exciting opportunity to make an immediate impact within a busy marketing function.

This is a fantastic opportunity for someone who can hit the ground running, bring fresh ideas, and help deliver engaging marketing campaigns across multiple channels.

Key Responsibilities
- Manage and create engaging content across social media platforms including Instagram, Facebook, and LinkedIn
- Support the planning and delivery of marketing campaigns
- Work closely with the company's videographer to develop creative content
- Create new marketing content to enhance brand engagement and visibility
- Update and maintain website content
- Support SEO initiatives to improve online performance and search rankings
- Monitor social media activity and identify opportunities to increase engagement
- Assist with wider marketing projects as required

About You

The successful candidate will:
- Have previous experience within a marketing role
- Be confident creating content for social media platforms
- Have experience managing LinkedIn, Facebook, and Instagram business accounts
- Possess strong written communication and content creation skills
- Have knowledge of website management and SEO best practices
- Be proactive, creative, and able to work independently
- Be able to quickly integrate into an established team and make a positive contribution from day one

What's in it for You?
- Competitive pay of up to £20.51 per hour
- Opportunity to join a supportive and experienced team
- Varied and creative workload
- Immediate start available
- Chance to make a real impact during a key period for the business
